p14-suction-stand.provenance: STAND modeled from Hamid's supplied design (DuoVac 80 / zinc-cliff-horizon-solar.grok.me) at the page's shown 80 cm height and about-48 cm five-caster base; NOT original factory CAD. CANISTERS = genuine Abadis 2 L CAD with official print, the same mesh and photo-derived print texture as approved p05-2l-cinematic (commit 1ce00c11, code 0402012). LINERS = approved 2 L suction bag with two sachets, the same genuine P02 CAD (lid, collar, cap, bag) as approved p02-cinematic (commit f54d8451); each liner is seated in a 2 L canister with the lid on the rim and the bag hanging inside. Official product is the portable suction trolley (P14), codes 060401 short / 060402 long. Official catalog does not print 80 cm and lists up to four 3 L jars; the official photograph (227665fb9960) shows two jars. Two sealed sachets and the recessed flow-stopper disc are presentation geometry from the approved P02 cinematic (no sachet/filter CAD) and appear in the cinematic, not this CAD-line plate. Supplied yellow/green lines do not meet the genuine lid PATIENT (tethered cap, +Z) or VACUUM (filter underneath, ~33.4, -30.4) ports - closest approaches 12.7 mm (left yellow to PATIENT) and 13.4 mm (right green to PATIENT); mid and back endpoints are 19-50 mm off. Lines were not snapped or rerouted; no hoses or fittings were invented. The Grok stand has three jar-side endpoints per side versus two genuine lid ports. Rear collar-mount faces aft and does not engage a stand hook. Lid skirt at y~-23 has r~60.33 mm versus the vessel inner mouth r=60.00 mm (0.33 mm genuine-CAD overlap, not altered).
p14-suction-stand.genuineLiners: P02 2L CAD lid/collar/bag/cap (commit f54d8451) seated in each canister; two sachets + recessed filter are approved P02 presentation geometry
